ns2:section.sectionText: This course will ask how neuroscience has informed our understanding of the nature, origins, and development of human cognition. We will focus on the use of fMRI, MRI, EEG/ERP, and fNIRS with human infants, children, and adults, while also incorporating findings from comparative neurophysiology and behavior. Test cases will include the investigation of language, literacy, mathematics, and social cognitive development.
